title: Craft hull material as an electret

tellings.quote: I think the material the craft is made from is an electric.
>> I think the material the craft is made from is an electret. And so, it always, just like a a magnet always has a magnetic field to it, an electret always has an electrostatic field to it.
tellings.difference: Adds the magnet analogy and dates it 1988-1989 rather than 1987-1989.
tellings.link_reason: Lazar's same claim that the S4 craft hull material is an electret with a permanent electrostatic field.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on recovered flying craft in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in Nevada, told podcast host Jesse Michels his idea about what the craft's hull was made of. He thinks it is an electret, a material that holds a permanent electric charge, so that just as a magnet always has a magnetic field, the craft always carries an electrostatic field around it.
